title: Tanvi Patri Secures Silver at Youth Olympics
indian_angle: Indian shuttler Tanvi Patri made history by winning a silver medal, showcasing India's rising talent on the international stage.
summary: The 15-year-old Indian shuttler Tanvi Patri clinched a silver medal at the Youth Olympics after a hard-fought final, demonstrating remarkable courage and composure.

title: Bindra, Sindhu Laud Tanvi Patri's Youth Olympics Performance
indian_angle: Indian sporting legends Abhinav Bindra and PV Sindhu praised young Indian shuttler Tanvi Patri, highlighting her potential for a bright future in badminton.
summary: Olympic gold medalist Abhinav Bindra and badminton star PV Sindhu have commended 15-year-old Tanvi Patri for her courageous performance at the Youth Olympics, despite a loss in the final.

title: BAI Announces Junior National Badminton Championships in Sikkim
indian_angle: The announcement of the 49th Junior National Badminton Championships in Sikkim provides a crucial platform for young Indian talent to compete and rise through the ranks.
summary: The Badminton Association of India (BAI) has released the eligibility list for the Yonex-Sunrise 49th Junior National Badminton Championships 2026, scheduled to be held in Sikkim from November 14th to 21st.

title: BAI Forms New Athletes Committee for Player Representation
indian_angle: The formation of the BAI Athletes Committee ensures Indian players have a direct voice in the sport's governance, promoting their welfare and development.
summary: The Badminton Association of India has announced the formation of its new Athletes Committee, aimed at providing better representation and support for Indian badminton players.

title: India Prepares for BWF World Junior Championships 2026 with National Camp
indian_angle: The national coaching camp at NCE Guwahati signifies India's focused preparation for the upcoming BWF World Junior Championships, aiming to nurture future champions.
summary: A national coaching camp is underway at the National Center of Excellence in Guwahati, preparing India's junior shuttlers for the BWF World Junior Championships 2026 in Cairo, Egypt.
